name: Securities Trade Identification
definition: Specifies the different identifications associated with a securities transaction.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner the account servicer and the market infrastructure.

PoolIdentification.name: Pool Identification
PoolIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

CollateralTransactionIdentification.name: Collateral Transaction Identification
CollateralTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of a collateral transaction.

ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.name: Client Triparty Collateral Transaction Identification
ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.definition: Unique reference identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the client's point of view.

TripartyAgentCollateralTransactionIdenti.name: Triparty Agent Collateral Transaction Identification
TripartyAgentCollateralTransactionIdenti.definition: Unique reference identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the triparty agent's point of view.

ProgramIdentification.name: Program Identification
ProgramIdentification.definition: Program reference which identifies a program trade.

BlockIdentification.name: Block Identification
BlockIdentification.definition: Reference of the linked message at the trade/block level which identifies a centrally matched transaction.

ComplianceIdentification.name: Compliance Identification
ComplianceIdentification.definition: Identification which represents this transaction for compliance purposes.

CSDTransactionIdentification.name: CSD Transaction Identification
CSDTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification given by the central securities depository  to the transaction.

CentralCounterpartyTransactionIdentifica.name: Central Counterparty Transaction Identification
CentralCounterpartyTransactionIdentifica.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the central counterparty.

CancellationRequestIdentification.name: Cancellation Request Identification
CancellationRequestIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the cancellation request as known by the instructing party.

CounterpartyMarketInfrastructureTransact.name: Counterparty Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
CounterpartyMarketInfrastructureTransact.definition: Identification of a counterparty transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

IdentifiedTrade.name: Identified Trade
IdentifiedTrade.definition: Trade for which one or more identifications are provided.
